content_sections.heading: About LNH Junior Resident
content_sections.text: Lok Nayak Hospital is a hospital of the Government of NCT of Delhi in New Delhi. This notice comes from the Office of the Medical Director, Lok Nayak Hospital, New Delhi - 110002 (Establishment-I), and is signed by Dr. Rajni, Director (Admin). The Junior Residents will be appointed at Lok Nayak Hospital itself.

content_sections.heading: Category-wise Vacancies
content_sections.text: The notice calls the 32 posts tentative. They may vary with the hospital's actual requirement and the vacancies available. *The 1 PwBD vacancy is included in the total of 32. It is not an extra post. PH candidates are counted within the category break-up above. Selection of Physically Handicapped (PH) or Persons with Benchmark Disabilities (PwBD) candidates follows horizontal reservation across the vertical social categories (General/UR, OBC, SC, ST and EWS), as mandated by government regulations.

content_sections.heading: Qualification and Experience
content_sections.text: The internship rule is strict. If an applicant submits an internship completion certificate dated before 30.11.2024, the notice says the candidature will be treated as cancelled. The notice does not ask for work experience. The application form has a field for "Experience (if any)". It also asks whether the candidate has worked as a Junior Resident earlier, on a regular or adhoc basis, in any Government Hospital. Concealing that information will lead to the candidature being cancelled. Candidates should check the official notification for the full eligibility conditions of the Junior Resident (Non-PG) post.

rows.qualification: MBBS degree from a recognized University/Institute or an equivalent qualification.

content_sections.heading: Age Limit
content_sections.text: The age limit is not exceeding 30 years as on 01.11.2026. Age is reckoned as on 01.11.2026. A further relaxation applies only if not enough eligible candidates are available under the criteria above. In that case, relaxation under Circular No. F.No. 121/26/2010/H&FW/OSHFW/1996-2045 dated 10.06.2011 of the Government of NCT of Delhi will be admissible, and the maximum age limit will be 40 years, irrespective of category. EWS: only EWS certificates issued by the Government of NCT of Delhi and valid for Financial Year 2026-2027 will be accepted. OBC: candidates must submit a Caste Certificate with a Non-Creamy Layer (NCL) Certificate. It must be issued after 31.03.2026 by the Govt. of NCT of Delhi for a community recognised as Other Backward Class under Government of NCT of Delhi Notification No. F.28(93)/91-92/SCST/P&S/4388 dated 20.01.1995, published in the Gazette of Delhi Extraordinary Part-IV.

content_sections.heading: Pay and Terms
content_sections.text: The notice states the pay as the basic pay "plus other admissible allowances". It does not list the individual allowances. It also does not mention the in-hand salary. Tenure: The appointment is initially for 89 days. It can be extended on the basis of a satisfactory work and conduct report from the concerned Head of Department (HOD) and a written request from the doctor concerned. It lasts until the regular appointment of a Junior Resident, whichever is earlier. Nature of appointment: The appointment is purely on a contractual/adhoc basis. It gives no right to regularisation or permanent absorption. Termination: Either side may end the contract with 10 days' notice or salary in lieu thereof. Leave: Junior Residents get 2½ days of leave per completed calendar month. No other leave will be granted. Unavailed leave will not be carried forward to the following months. Private practice: Private practice of any kind is strictly prohibited. No NOC: Selected candidates who accept the offer and join the hospital will not be issued a No Objection Certificate (NOC) of any kind for any purpose, including passport and visa. Service rules: Other conditions of service are governed by orders issued or endorsed from time to time by the Government of NCT of Delhi. Legal disputes lie exclusively with the Courts of Delhi/New Delhi.

rows.pay_level_pay: Pay Matrix Level-10 as per 7th CPC (Basic Pay Rs. 56,100/- per month) plus other admissible allowances

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Selection will be made strictly on the basis of merit through the interview only. The notice does not mention a written test. The decision of the Chairman and the Selection Board will be final and binding in case of any dispute. If there are many applicants, the interviews will continue on the following working days, excluding Sundays and holidays. A valid DMC acknowledgment slip will be accepted at the time of the interview. No TA/DA will be paid to candidates who appear for the interview.

rows.as_printed: Room No. 139, OPD First Floor, Lok Nayak Hospital, New Delhi-110002

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for LNH Junior Resident
content_sections.text: Fill in the application in the prescribed format. The form "Application for the Post of Junior Resident on Adhoc Basis in LNH" is printed at the end of the notice. Tick your category (UR, OBC, SC, ST, PH or EWS) and affix a latest passport-size photograph on a white background. Fill in your MBBS year-wise marks and attempts, your internship details, any earlier Junior Resident service in a Government Hospital, and your experience, if any. Then sign the declaration. Attach self-attested photocopies of the documents in the order listed under "Enclosures" in the form. Submit the hard copy at E-I Branch, MRD Block, 1st Floor, Lok Nayak Hospital, New Delhi-110002. Soft copies will not be accepted. Make sure the application is received by 30.11.2026, 01:00 PM. No application or candidate will be entertained after 01:00 PM. Report for the interview on 15.12.2026 at 10:00 AM at Room No. 139, OPD First Floor, Lok Nayak Hospital. There is no application or interview fee.

content_sections.heading: Documents Required
content_sections.text: Self-attested photocopies to submit with the application, as listed in the notice: Birth Certificate or Matriculation Certificate Educational Qualification Certificates (MBBS/MD/MS/DNB) Mark sheet/Degree/Provisional Degree Valid DMC Registration Certificate/DMC Acknowledgment/Provisional DMC registration Internship Completion Certificate (internship completed after 30.11.2024 and before 30.11.2026) FMGE Pass Certificate (if applicable) Caste/Category Certificate (if applicable) The enclosure checklist in the application form asks for these items in this order: copy of Date of Birth Certificate and 10th Pass Certificate; Caste Certificate (SC/ST); EWS Certificate (if applicable) issued by GNCT of Delhi; OBC Certificate, if applicable, issued by GNCT of Delhi; PH Certificate, if applicable; MBBS Degree; Internship Certificate; Valid DMC; and one original Demand Draft, if applicable. Originals at joining: Selected candidates must bring all original certificates for verification at the time of joining. These are the MBBS/MD/MS/DNB Degree, Internship Completion Certificate, Matriculation/DOB Certificate, valid DMC Registration, FMGE Pass Certificate, and Experience Certificate, if any. Selected candidates will be taken on strength only when they produce a valid DMC Registration Certificate.

faq.question: Q1. How many Junior Resident vacancies are in LNH Recruitment 2026??
faq.answer: There are 32 tentative posts of Junior Resident (Non-PG): UR 15, OBC 8, SC 4, ST 2 and EWS 3. The total includes 1 PwBD vacancy.

faq.question: Q2. What is the last date to apply for the LNH Junior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Applications must be received by 30 November 2026 up to 01:00 PM. No application will be entertained after 01:00 PM.

faq.question: Q3. What qualification is needed for LNH Junior Resident (Non-PG)?
faq.answer: Candidates need an MBBS degree from a recognized University/Institute or an equivalent qualification. They must also have completed their internship after 30.11.2024 and before 30.11.2026.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit for the LNH Junior Resident posts?
faq.answer: The age limit is not exceeding 30 years as on 01.11.2026. SC/ST candidates get 5 years of relaxation and OBC candidates 3 years. If not enough eligible candidates are available, the maximum age limit will be 40 years, irrespective of category.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary of an LNH Junior Resident?
faq.answer: The pay is Pay Matrix Level-10 as per 7th CPC, with a Basic Pay of Rs. 56,100/- per month plus other admissible allowances.

faq.question: Q6. Are allowances paid on top of the basic pay?
faq.answer: Yes. The notice gives the basic pay of Rs. 56,100/- per month "plus other admissible allowances", but it does not list the allowances.

faq.question: Q7. Is there an application fee for LNH Junior Resident Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that there is no application or interview fee. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

faq.question: Q8. How do I apply for the LNH Junior Resident posts?
faq.answer: Submit the application in the prescribed format, with self-attested document copies, at E-I Branch, MRD Block, 1st Floor, Lok Nayak Hospital, New Delhi-110002. The application must be a hard copy; soft copies are not accepted.

faq.question: Q9. How will LNH select the Junior Residents?
faq.answer: Selection is strictly on merit through the interview only. The interview is on 15 December 2026 at 10:00 AM at Room No. 139, OPD First Floor, Lok Nayak Hospital.

faq.question: Q10. Is the LNH Junior Resident job permanent?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely contractual/adhoc, initially for 89 days, and gives no right to regularisation or permanent absorption. Either side may end it with 10 days' notice or salary in lieu thereof.
